mapper.sql: c.contain_id, c.contain_no, c.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, c.ncr_id, n.ncr_no, c.from_date, c.to_date, c.reason, c.status, c.lot_cnt, (select count(*) from qms_contain_lot x where x.contain_id = c.contain_id and x.released_at is null) as held_cnt, c.closed_at, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.row_ver
from qms_contain c join mst_item i on i.item_id = c.item_id left join qms_ncr n on n.ncr_id = c.ncr_id

where.if: and (c.contain_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or i.item_cd ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or n.ncr_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or c.reason ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\')

mapper.select:
select order by
c.contain_no i.item_cd c.from_date c.status c.created_at
desc,
c.contain_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}

select x.contain_lot_id, x.lot_id, l.lot_no, l.qty_created, l.unit_cd, l.occurred_at, x.released_at, x.released_by, x.release_reason from qms_contain_lot x join lot_master l on l.lot_id = x.lot_id where x.contain_id = #{id} order by l.occurred_at, x.lot_id
select item_id, item_cd, item_nm from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}
select ncr_id, item_id from qms_ncr where ncr_no = #{ncrNo}
mapper.insert: insert into qms_contain (contain_id, comp_cd, contain_no, item_id, ncr_id, from_date, to_date, reason, lot_cnt, created_by, updated_by) values (#{id}, hb_current_comp(), #{no}, #{itemId}, #{ncrId}, #{from}, #{to}, #{reason}, #{lotCnt}, #{by}, #{by})
insert into qms_contain_lot (comp_cd, contain_id, lot_id, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{id}, #{lotId}, #{by})
mapper.update: update qms_contain_lot set released_at = now(), released_by = #{by}, release_reason = #{reason} where contain_id = #{id} and lot_id = #{lotId} and released_at is null
mapper.select: select contain_id from qms_contain where contain_id = #{id} for update
select count(*) from qms_contain_lot where contain_id = #{id} and released_at is null
mapper.update: update qms_contain set status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = now(), row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where contain_id = #{id} and status = 'OPEN'
